concern_results.conclusion: Trigger logic matches intent: in-chain findings counted from supplied prior receipts, cross-chain counted only from the succession receipt's own status, current round must itself be findings; claim_strength occupies the asserted indexes in build (5) and release (7) concern lists, and the relocated wording-only text is verbatim under its pointer.

Change is strictly additive — one derived counter, one boolean on the succession dict, one required-trigger value, one allowed-action value; it blocks nothing findings_returned does not already block, touches no credential/egress/mutation path, and cannot make a failing round pass.

Missing, non-findings, or absent predecessor leaves the count at in-chain rounds; succession does not compose so a fresh third chain counts nothing; a plan omitting claim_strength fails closed rc=2 with no client_sequence file, proving failure before any provider runs.

Three positive probes (in-chain recurrence, cross-succession recurrence, plan coverage) and two negative control legs (untracked and tracked first findings rounds) sit at the owning layer with exact json_fields assertions; every concern-index expectation shifted consistently with the new ordering.

All five suites carrying review-plan fixtures gained claim_strength; envelope changes are new members in existing arrays, not new shapes; contract pointer and wording-only content pins are both asserted in the extraction gate; the three delegated lane-budget numbers are pinned by new contract anchors that fail closed.

Reverting the commit restores prior behavior with no migration and no persisted state; prior_findings_rounds is computed fresh at freeze time and older receipts remain readable since all additions are additive.

prior_findings_rounds is exposed in the frozen profile, the trigger and allowed action appear in the round's own result envelope, and SKILL.md now requires the work summary to record the keep/delete/narrow/replace decision, its recurrence scope, and its ratifier.

Counting claims are bounded to the chain plus the named predecessor and the docs state that bound explicitly; over-firing is declared as design rather than hidden; RED-baseline claims name the exact owning assertions and control counts instead of absolutes.

The shared gate is edited only to add a required concern and a required trigger with an allowed action; no controller-required concern, challenge budget, fail-closed path, or wording-only acceptance criterion is removed or narrowed, and no waiver or completion authority is granted.
